# useThisHook

> Promise-based confirm/prompt dialogs and 53 tree-shakeable React hooks. Zero runtime dependencies, TypeScript, SSR-safe.

Install with `npm i usethishook`. React 18+ is the only peer dependency.

- Docs: https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/usethishook
- GitHub: https://github.com/senthilkumar979/useThisHook
- Full hook reference: https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/llms-full.txt

## Docs

- [Home](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/): Install command, hook index, and what the library is for
- [Compare](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/compare): useThisHook vs usehooks-ts and react-use
- [MCP](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/mcp): usethishook-mcp for Cursor and Claude Desktop

## State

- [useBoolean](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useBoolean): Boolean state with toggle helpers.
- [useDisclosure](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useDisclosure): Open, close, and toggle for menus and dialogs.
- [useDebounce](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useDebounce): Delay updates until the value stops changing.
- [useThrottle](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useThrottle): Limit how often a value updates.
- [useInterval](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useInterval): Declarative setInterval that always calls the latest callback.
- [useCopyToClipboard](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useCopyToClipboard): Copy text with the Clipboard API.
- [useLocalStorage](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useLocalStorage): Persist JSON-serializable state in localStorage.
- [useSessionStorage](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useSessionStorage): Persist JSON-serializable state in sessionStorage.

## Browser

- [useOnlineStatus](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useOnlineStatus): Subscribe to the browser online/offline state.
- [useOnlineQueue](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useOnlineQueue): Queue work while offline and flush when online.
- [useStorageQuota](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useStorageQuota): Origin storage usage and quota from estimate().
- [useInstallPrompt](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useInstallPrompt): Capture and replay the PWA beforeinstallprompt event.
- [useCrossTabState](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useCrossTabState): JSON state synced across browser tabs.
- [useFingerprint](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useFingerprint): Client-side visitor id from browser fingerprint signals.
- [useMediaQuery](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useMediaQuery): Subscribe to a CSS media query.
- [useWindowSize](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useWindowSize): Current viewport width and height.
- [useOnClickOutside](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useOnClickOutside): Run a handler when the user clicks outside a ref.
- [useOverlay](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useOverlay): Promise-based overlay / modal rendering.
- [useStepFlow](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useStepFlow): Multi-step wizard that resolves when the flow finishes.
- [useAsyncSelect](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useAsyncSelect): Open the native file picker and await the result.
- [useEventListener](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useEventListener): Subscribe to a DOM or window event with a stable handler.
- [useTimeout](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useTimeout): Run a callback once after a delay. null pauses.
- [useKeyPress](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useKeyPress): True while a keyboard key is held (ignores text fields).
- [useScrollLock](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useScrollLock): Lock and unlock document body scroll.
- [useDocumentVisibility](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useDocumentVisibility): Whether the document tab is visible or hidden.
- [useIdle](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useIdle): True after a period of no user activity.
- [useKeyboardShortcut](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useKeyboardShortcut): Register a key combo on window and clean it up.
- [useLongPress](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useLongPress): Mouse and touch press-and-hold handlers.

## App

- [useStableCallback](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useStableCallback): Stable function identity, always-latest implementation.
- [useUpdateEffect](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useUpdateEffect): useEffect that skips the first mount.
- [useResetState](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useResetState): Local state that resets when the source key changes.
- [useAsyncAction](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useAsyncAction): Pending, error, and data around one async action.
- [useAsyncState](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useAsyncState): Typed idle, loading, success, and error for async work.
- [useOptimisticAction](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useOptimisticAction): Apply a local update, confirm or roll back.
- [useRetry](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useRetry): Retry an async function with backoff and cancel.
- [useAsyncQueue](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useAsyncQueue): FIFO async tasks with a concurrency cap.
- [usePolling](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/usePolling): Interval polling that pauses when the tab is hidden.
- [useRenderTracker](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useRenderTracker): Count renders and log commits in development.
- [useWhyDidYouUpdate](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useWhyDidYouUpdate): Log which values changed between renders.
- [useDebouncedCallback](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useDebouncedCallback): Debounce calling a function, with cancel.
- [useThrottledCallback](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useThrottledCallback): Throttle calling a function, with cancel.
- [useFields](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useFields): Small form state with setField, dirty, and optional schema.
- [useAmountInput](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useAmountInput): Locale amount input with grouping, decimals, and cursor restore.
- [useList](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useList): Insert, update, remove, and reorder items with ids.
- [useSelection](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useSelection): Single or multi id selection for lists and tables.
- [useSearchState](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useSearchState): URL search params as React state.
- [useConfirm](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useConfirm): Await a yes/no dialog from a click handler.
- [usePrompt](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/usePrompt): Await a single string from a small dialog.
- [useControllableState](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useControllableState): Controlled and uncontrolled state in one setter.
- [useUnsavedChanges](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useUnsavedChanges): Warn on tab close and confirm in-app leave when dirty.
- [useElementSize](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useElementSize): Live width and height of an element via ResizeObserver.
- [useInView](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/useInView): Whether an element intersects the viewport (or a root).
- [usePagination](https://usethishook.mentorbridge.in/usePagination): Page, page size, offset, and next/prev with clamping.
